items.title: Strategy Sets New BTC Holdings Record After $143M Bitcoin Purchase
items.summary: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin treasury firm bought 1,665 BTC last week, taking its holdings above its previous record to 847,666 BTC.

items.title: ‘Even more orange’: Strategy buys 1,665 bitcoin for $143 million as total holdings reach 847,666 BTC
items.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $70 billion.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $2.4B in biggest inflow week since October 2025
items.summary: Daily inflows slowed as Bitcoin pulled back from above $87,100, while Ether and XRP ETFs also attracted fresh capital during the week.
